portal_subtitle: Tender announcements, applications and live online bidding in one place.
tenders_empty: No announcements match the selected filters.
tender_docs_empty: Tender documentation is published by the organizer and will appear on this page.
tender_not_found_text: The announcement may have been unpublished, or the link is incorrect.
page_not_found_text: Check the address or return to the home page.
page_error_text: The page could not be displayed. Try again - if the error persists, contact the administrator.
howto_title: How to participate in a tender
howto_intro: The university leases its premises through open tenders: the participant offering the highest rate wins.
howto_step_register_text: Create a participant account - an email address is all you need.
howto_step_prepare_text: Study the announcement and tender documentation, and pay the guarantee fee - it equals the starting monthly rent.
howto_step_submit_text: Applications are accepted strictly until the deadline stated in the announcement. Late submissions are rejected by the system.
howto_step_trade_text: Qualified participants bid online with a bid step of at least 5%. The winner signs the lease agreement.
auth_oidc_failed: Signing in with the external account did not complete. Try again or use your password.
auth_register_hint: Enter your BIN or IIN and verify an email address or phone number to submit applications and take part in auctions.
auth_verification_hint: Enter the eight-digit code sent to {destination}.
objects_empty: No premises match the selected filters.
calc_base_rate: Base rate per m² per year
calc_vat_note: VAT is not included in the base rate.
tender_draft_visibility_hint: This is a draft: it has not been published yet and is visible only to organizers.
tender_new_no_objects: Create an object first - lots are built from objects.
tender_dates_hint: At publication time, at least 10 calendar days must remain before envelope opening.
my_applications_empty: No applications yet - pick a tender with open intake.
open_tenders_empty: No tenders are accepting applications right now.
apply_price_hint: The price is encrypted and unavailable to everyone, including you and administrators, until applications are opened.
application_package_complete: The required package of five PDFs is complete. Files remain encrypted until opening.
application_package_incomplete: Attach all five required PDFs. Nobody, including you or an administrator, can download them before opening.
prices_sealed_note: Prices are sealed until envelope opening.
opening_hint: Opening is possible no earlier than the scheduled meeting time; prices and documents become visible to the commission afterwards.
notif_auction_invitation: You are admitted to the auction: {tender}, lot {lot}. Starting bid {bid}. Auction: {date} (online).
notif_application_rejected: Your application was rejected by the commission. Grounds: {reason}
notif_runner_up_offer: The winner withdrew: the contract for lot {lot} of tender “{tender}” is offered to you for {amount}
notif_tender_amended: Documentation of tender “{tender}” has changed (revision {version}). New submission deadline: {deadline}
notif_protocol_published: Protocol {number} for tender “{tender}” has been published
auth_forgot_password: Forgot your password? Ask an administrator for a one-time password. Change it here:
auth_password_change_hint: The current password is required: without it, access to an open page would mean access to the account forever.
admin_users_hint: A role grants the permissions defined by the access policy; every grant and revocation is recorded in the audit log (FR-1503).
admin_users_lifecycle_hint: A disabled account cannot sign in and loses its open sessions; its applications, contracts and deposit remain. The password is reset to a one-time value: shown once and stored nowhere.
admin_reset_password_warning: Write it down now - it will not be shown again. Hand it to the owner and ask them to change it right after signing in.
admin_mrp_hint: The base rate is 1.5 MCI per m² per year (Appendix 4, cl. 137). Changing the value does not alter past calculations: the lot stores a snapshot of its rate calculation.
admin_coefficients_hint: Multipliers are versioned by effective date (FR-202): a new version is added while the previous one stays in the reference data and keeps explaining past calculations.
admin_holidays_hint: Public holidays of Kazakhstan: every «business day» in the Rules is counted against them (FR-1701). Weekends are handled automatically.
admin_audit_chain_hint: The change log is bound by a hash chain (INV-A01): a background pass verifies it, and its latest result is shown here. A break means records were altered bypassing the log.
admin_audit_chain_broken_at: Divergence starts at entry No. {id} - the log was altered bypassing append-only.
auction_connection_offline: Connection lost: the data may be stale, reconnecting
auction_watcher_hint: You are watching the auction: only participants admitted to this lot may bid.
auction_extended_used: The single extension has been used (clause 68).
auction_no_winner: No bids were placed - no winner determined.
auction_finished_early: The auction was finished early by common consent.
auction_not_scheduled: The auction room is not open yet.
auction_recording_hint: The recording is kept with the auction record (cl. 72). The secretary adds the link once results are summed up; an empty field removes a wrong link.
results_protocol_hint: The results protocol is issued after bidding closes on every lot (within 3 business days).
objects_subtitle: University premises, buildings, structures and land plots: what is available, what is up for tender, and what is already leased.
commission_none: No commission is currently in office
meeting_open_first: Open the meeting with a quorum first
coi_hint: The declaration is filed before the meeting. If a conflict exists, the commission decides on recusal.
voting_tally: In favour: {for}, against: {against}; present and eligible: {eligible}
voting_pending: Not everyone present has voted yet
deadline_notify_admitted: Notify qualified participants of the auction
deadline_failed_protocol: Draw up the failed tender protocol
deadline_contract_draft: Draft the contract with the winner
deadline_landlord_sign: Sign the contract as the landlord
deadline_contract_handover: Send the contract copy to the tenant
deadline_notify_amendment: Notify participants of the documentation amendment
deadline_notify_cancellation: Notify participants of the tender cancellation
deadline_special_review: Prepare the conclusion on the request
deadline_special_decision: Take the board decision on the request
deadline_deposit_top_up: Top the deposit back up after a write-off
deadline_deposit_refund: Refund the deposit to the tenant
fee_confirm_hint: There is no bank integration: the operator enters the amount and payment date from the bank statement. The fee equals the lot's monthly rate and must arrive at least two business days before the first stage (cl. 23, 25).
deposit_not_open: The deposit opens once the contract is concluded (cl. 126).
deposit_refund_confirm_description: The refund will be posted to the deposit account. This cannot be undone.
auction_your_turn: Your turn: raise the bid or leave the auction.
auction_waiting_turn: Another participant is on turn - wait for yours.
failure_ground_winners_evaded: the winner and the runner-up evaded
failure_consequence_board: the matter goes to the Board
failure_repeat_created: A draft repeat tender has been created - see the tender list.
contract_terms_frozen: rate from the auction, not subject to change
amendments_hint: A supplementary agreement changes only what the Rules allow (cl. 125): the essential terms - rate, object, term and tenant - stay untouched (FR-901).
reports_hint: Registries of decisions, contracts and receipts for a period, with export. A registry shows the facts the system recorded - the Rules define no report form.
reports_empty: No records for the selected period.
reports_forbidden: Report registries are available to the organiser, the finance department and the Board.
evasion_consequence: The evader's guarantee fee is held (cl. 116); the right to the contract passes to the runner-up under the same terms (cl. 117–118).
evasion_contract_terminated: The contract is terminated by evasion: the fee is held (cl. 116).
evaders_hint: Applications of evaders are rejected automatically (cl. 52.4, 120).
amendments_decline_hint: The tender terms have changed: you may decline participation, the guarantee fee is refunded (cl. 26.5).
amend_hint: Documentation may be amended no later than 2 calendar days before the deadline; acceptance is extended by at least 10 calendar days (cl. 27).
dossier_hint: The dossier is assembled automatically from process events and kept together with the documents (cl. 16).
dossier_decision_hint: The decision dossier is assembled automatically: the application, its documents, the unit's conclusion and the Board decision (cl. 97).
calc_hourly_hint: The rate starts at 2 MCI per hour and is adjusted by the Annex 4 coefficients; area is not part of it.
calc_hourly_floor_applied: The coefficients would lower the rate - the 2 MCI/hour minimum applies (cl. 97).
contract_draft: Draw up the contract for lot {seq}
special_new_title: Application for property under the special order
special_new_subtitle: Annex 3 form: a category from the list of clause 87 and the grounds for the application.
special_benefit_educational: equipment used in the educational process
special_purpose_hint: The substance of the application: what the property is requested for (cl. 88).
special_progress_empty: The application is awaiting the authorised unit's conclusion (cl. 89).
special_rationale_hint: The rationale is published together with the outcome (cl. 97).
special_awaits_review: A decision is possible only after the authorised unit's conclusion (cl. 89–90).
notif_special_decided: A decision has been taken on the special-order application ({category}): {decision}
special_investment_hint: In the investment category the larger amount has priority (cl. 97).
special_competition_redirect: {total} applications compete for the property - the matter goes to the general order (cl. 86).
special_competition_amounts: Competing applications: {rivals}; the largest investment is {best} ₸.
special_competition_comparable: The amounts are comparable - the choice is the Board's (cl. 97).
special_redirected_to_tender: The matter was referred to the general order: the application joined a tender together with the competing ones (cl. 86).
investment_term_hint: An investment contract runs for no more than seven years (cl. 94).
public_records_hint: Application outcomes with their rationale, rate justifications and investment acceptance acts (cl. 90, 92, 97). Each item stays available for six months.
publications_hint: The outcome and its rationale are published within five business days (cl. 97); investment acceptance acts follow cl. 92.
publications_not_ready: the document is not generated yet
investment_rate_hint: The server computes the rate and its justification from the Annex 4 factors - the calculation is published (cl. 97).
land_plots_hint: Characteristics of plots offered to investors for dormitories and other purposes (cl. 104). Applications for a published plot are filed from the cabinet.
land_plot_apply_hint: Investors apply from the participant cabinet (cl. 105).
land_no_objects: Create an object of kind “Land plot” in the object registry first.
land_contract_hint: The contract carries the cl. 107 conditions: neither the plot nor the buildings erected on it may be pledged. The rate comes from the Annex 4 calculator.
investment_attachments_complete: The document set of cl. 91 is complete.
validation_id_number: Check the BIN/IIN: 12 digits with a matching check digit
validation_phone_charset: A phone number is written with digits; “+”, space, hyphen and brackets are allowed
validation_phone_length: A phone number has {min} to {max} digits
validation_file_type: PDF, JPEG, PNG and TIFF are accepted
validation_file_too_large: The file is larger than {max} MB - reduce or split the document
list_truncated: Showing the first {count} records - the selection has more.
reports_truncated: Showing the first {count} records for the period. The full registry is in the CSV export.
rule_tender_status_transition: The tender is in a different status, so this action is not available for it.
rule_tender_publication_terms: A tender is published with lots and dates: at least 10 calendar days must remain before the envelopes are opened.
rule_tender_documentation_change: The documentation and the application deadline cannot be changed at this point.
rule_tender_cancellation: The tender or lot can no longer be cancelled: a contract has been concluded or it was cancelled earlier.
rule_tender_failure_ground: A tender may be declared void only on a ground set by the Rules, and the protocol follows that decision.
rule_application_intake_closed: Applications are not being accepted for this tender.
rule_application_deadline_passed: The application deadline has passed, so the application can no longer be changed.
rule_application_already_submitted: You have already submitted an application for this lot.
rule_application_not_pending: The application is not in the submitted state, so this action is not possible.
rule_sealed_price_key_missing: The price offer was not stored: the envelope encryption key is missing.
rule_commission_composition: There is no active commission with an approved composition, or the composition does not meet the Rules.
rule_commission_meeting: The commission meeting has not been scheduled or opened, or there is no quorum.
rule_commission_vote: Voting on this item is not allowed: check the voting right and the voting order.
rule_admission_notice: Admitted participants cannot be notified now: the admission protocol is required and the notice is sent once.
rule_auction_not_running: Trading is not running right now, so the bid is not accepted.
rule_auction_start_price_missing: The starting price is undefined: the lot has no admitted applications with a price offer.
rule_bid_below_minimum: The bid is below the minimum: it must be the current maximum plus the bidding step.
rule_auction_timer: The bidding time has expired, or the timer has already been extended.
rule_auction_turn_order: It is another participant's turn, or you have dropped out of the bidding.
rule_auction_announcement: The offer cannot be announced at this point.
rule_auction_result_mismatch: The winner or the runner-up does not belong to this auction.
rule_result_protocol: The results protocol is not possible yet: bidding on the lots has not finished.
rule_protocol_publication: The protocol cannot be published: the printable form is missing or it has already been published.
rule_publication_retention: Public access has expired or has already been closed: the document is kept in the case file.
rule_public_record_link: The link to the recording is added after the results have been summed up.
rule_dossier_immutable: Case file materials cannot be changed or detached.
rule_contract_conclusion: No contract can be drafted for the lot: bidding is unfinished or there is no winner.
rule_contract_stage_order: Contract steps follow an order: this step is already done or its turn has not come.
rule_contract_terms_immutable: The essential terms of the contract cannot be changed.
rule_winner_evasion: This is possible only after evasion has been declared and for a contract handed to the party.
rule_act_order: The order of the acts is wrong: the property is handed over under a registered contract and returned afterwards.
rule_contract_registration: Registration requires a contract signed by both parties and a number in the register.
rule_contract_amendment: An addendum is made to a registered contract and cannot be changed once issued.
rule_document_check_incomplete: The document check is unfinished or already closed by the landlord's signature.
rule_contract_deposit: The deposit is paid and refunded under the contract terms: check the amount and the timing.
rule_guarantee_deposit: The guarantee fee was not accepted: check the amount, the payment date and the application status.
rule_deposit_refund_reason: A refund is issued only on a ground from the list in the Rules.
rule_ledger_entry: The ledger entry is invalid: check the operation type and the amount.
rule_ledger_balance_negative: The account does not have enough funds for this operation.
rule_special_order_application: The special-order application is incomplete, or the document is attached at the wrong time.
rule_special_order_transition: This status transition of the special-order application is not allowed.
rule_special_order_competition: There are competing applications in this category, so the matter goes to the general procedure.
rule_board_decision: The board decides on a submitted application, and the decision cannot be changed afterwards.
rule_board_decision_without_opinion: The board cannot decide without an opinion from the responsible unit.
rule_investment_contract: The investment contract, acceptance act or extension does not meet the Rules.
rule_investment_documents_missing: The mandatory documents of the investment project are missing.
rule_benefit_scheme: The conditions of the benefit scheme are not met.
rule_benefit_approval_missing: The benefit applies only with the approval of the Academic Council.
rule_spinoff_teaching_quota: The spin-off does not cover the teaching quota required by the Rules.
rule_special_publication: The special-order publication is not possible: the material is missing or it has already been published.
rule_land_application: The land plot application or the decision on it does not meet the Rules.
rule_land_contract_terms_missing: The land plot contract does not fix the mandatory special terms.
rule_object_in_use: The property is used by lots or contracts, so it cannot be deleted.
rule_status_not_allowed: The action is not available in the current status of the record.
rule_append_only_table: This record is append-only: it cannot be changed or deleted.
rule_overlapping_period: The period overlaps an existing one.
rule_related_record_missing: The related record was not found or belongs to a different object.
rule_other_rule: The operation was rejected by the rules. Contact the organizer for details.
rule_unknown: The operation was rejected by a rule this version of the interface does not know. Reload the page.
footer_official_notice: The official portal for renting Toraighyrov University property: announcements, amendments and protocols are published here.
home_trust_text: Tenders follow the university Rules: announcements, changes of terms and protocols are published on this portal only.
home_tile_land_text: Details of the plots offered to investors for construction projects.
home_tile_special_text: Application decisions, rate justifications and acceptance certificates.
howto_questions_text: The terms of a specific tender, its lots and its documentation are published in the announcement card.
auth_login_hint: Sign in to submit applications, take part in bidding and work with contracts. Announcements and results are open without signing in.
auth_password_who: This page sits next to sign-in: come here after an administrator resets your password, or from someone else's device where opening the cabinet makes no sense.
amendments_decline_confirm_text: Your application will be withdrawn and the guarantee fee refunded (cl. 26.5). This cannot be undone.
amendments_declined: Application withdrawn; the fee will be refunded
application_detail_withdraw_confirm_desc: The application will be removed from the registration journal. This cannot be undone.
auction_absent_confirm_description: {name} (starting price {amount}) will be marked absent in the protocol. This cannot be undone.
auction_finish_confirm_description: The winner and runner-up will be recorded; no more bids are accepted. This cannot be undone.
auction_finish_confirm_early: The timer is still running: the auction will finish early. The winner and runner-up will be recorded.
commission_vote_confirm_description: Your vote “{vote}” on {applicant}'s application is entered into the protocol and cannot be changed.
contract_act_return_confirm_description: The return act records the end of use of the object. This cannot be undone.
contract_evasion_confirm_description: The winner is added to the evader registry and the guarantee fee is forfeited. This cannot be undone.
dossier_empty: Dossier documents will appear as the tender proceeds
investment_extend_confirm_description: The contract term will be extended: {extension}. The extension is recorded in the registry.
land_contract_confirm_description: A land-use contract draft will be created from the application data.
land_decide_confirm_description: The Board's decision is entered into the registry and cannot be changed.
land_publish_confirm_description: The plot becomes visible to investors on the portal. Publication cannot be undone.
notif_filter_empty: No notifications match the selected filter
notif_page_truncated: Showing the first {count} notifications — older ones exist
participant_contracts_empty_hint: A contract appears after you win a tender and the guarantee fee is confirmed
protocols_my_empty: No protocols for your applications yet
tender_change_cancel_confirm_description: The cancellation is published on the portal and applications close. This cannot be undone.
dash_subtitle: What needs you today, across all your roles.
dash_all_clear: No queues - nothing is waiting on you.
objects_page_hint: University buildings, premises, structures and land plots. Objects enter tender lots from here.
object_create_hint: Area and address go into the tender announcement; the area also feeds the rate calculation.
org_dash_subtitle: The state of the registries and the deadlines closest at hand.
auction_needs_protocol: The auction opens once the admission protocol exists; until then there are no lots here.
tender_changes_closed: Amendments are only possible until applications close (cl. 27).
apply_confirm_description: Price: {price}. Guarantee fee: {fee}. Applications close: {deadline}. The application enters the registration journal.
participant_dash_subtitle: How your applications are progressing and which tenders are still open.
app_next_submitted: Awaiting confirmation of the guarantee fee
my_applications_empty_hint: An application appears here as soon as you submit it.
open_tenders_empty_hint: When applications open, the tender shows up here.
secretary_dash_subtitle: Tenders in progress, nearest meeting or deadline first.
secretary_tenders_empty_hint: A tender shows up here as soon as the organizer publishes it.
commission_dash_subtitle: Tenders under admission review, plus the commission and its quorum.
commission_tenders_empty_hint: A tender appears here once applications open.
finance_dash_subtitle: Confirming guarantee fees from the bank statement, and the deposit ledger.
board_dash_subtitle: Special-order requests referred to the board.
board_requests_empty_hint: A request lands here once the department has issued its opinion.
admin_revoke_confirm_description: The role "{role}" will be removed from {user}, closing access to that cabinet. The action is written to the audit log.
admin_deactivate_confirm_description: {user} will lose the ability to sign in. The account can be re-enabled; the action is written to the audit log.
admin_announcement_hint: Create or edit the announcement and control whether it appears on the public home page.
admin_announcement_plain_text_hint: Paragraphs and line breaks are preserved. HTML and Markdown are not used.
admin_announcement_publish: Show the announcement on the home page
admin_announcement_default_body:
On an electronic ascending-price tender for leasing the real estate of Toraighyrov University NJSC

Tender organizer: Toraighyrov University NJSC (64 Lomov Street, Pavlodar, Republic of Kazakhstan) announces an electronic ascending-price tender for leasing the Company's real estate.

The tender is held electronically on the University's official website.

Lease term: 12 months from the date the agreement is signed.
